verses.text: Ayik toxo ix tek'k'aj yopisio winhaj Roboam chi' snaani, ix yaktankan winh sk'anab'ajan sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab'.
Yujto pit ix yutej sb'a heb' t'a Jehová chi', yuj chi' ayik oye' ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Roboam chi' reyal, ix jawi winhaj Sisac sreyal Egipto yak' owal t'a Jerusalén.

Ix jawi winh yet' mil 200 karruaje yik owal yet' pax 60 mil soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' pax jantak heb' winh soldado, manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb' winh. Ha heb' aj Libia, heb' aj Suka yet' heb' aj Etiopía ix kot yet' heb' aj Egipto chi'.
Ix ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' ayoch smuroal t'a Judá yuj heb' masanto ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Yuj chi' ix k'och winh schekab' Dios skuchan Semaías t'a yichanh winhaj Roboam chi' yet' t'a heb' ayoch yajalil t'a smakb'en Judá. Molanek' heb' t'a Jerusalén chi' yuj xiwelal t'a winhaj Sisac chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Icha tik ix aj yalan Jehová: Yujto ix in eyaktejkani, yuj chi' toxo ix ex waktejkan t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Sisac chi', xchi, xchi winh.
Ha heb' yajal yaj yet' winh rey chi', emnakilxonhej ix aj yojtakanel spitalil heb', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Smojton wal icha chi' tzonh yutej Jehová chi', xchi heb'.

Ayik ix yilan Jehová to emnakil ix yutej sb'a heb', ix yalanxi t'a winhaj Semaías chi' icha tik: Yujto emnakil ix yutej sb'a heb', yuj chi' manh ol in satel heb', palta toxo wal ol in kol heb', manhxo ol wak'lab'ej winhaj Sisac chi' yik swak'anb'at jantak yowal in k'ol t'a chonhab' Jerusalén chi'.

Anhej b'ian to ol kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Sisac chi', yik wach' ol nachajel yuj heb' to sekojtak wak'ji serwil t'a yichanh pax yak'ji serwil heb' winh sreyal juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional, xchi Jehová.

Ix jawi winhaj Sisac sreyal Egipto chi' yak' owal t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix yik'anb'at jantak b'eyumal winh sik'an t'a stemplo Jehová yet' t'a spalakio winh rey chi'. Ix yik'anpaxb'at juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' winh, haton juntzanh nab'a oro b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Salomón.
Haxo yet' k'een bronke ix sb'o juntzanhxo smaklab' jul-lab' winhaj Roboam chi' sk'exulok juntzanh nab'a oro chi', ix yak'ankan winh t'a heb' stanhwan sti' spalakio winh chi'.
Ayik sb'at winh rey chi' juntak el t'a stemplo Jehová, syik'anb'at maklab' jul-lab' chi' heb'. Haxo spaxta heb', syik'anxikanoch heb' t'a yet'tal b'aj stanhwej chi'.

Yujto ix yak'xioch sb'a winhaj Roboam chi' t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yuj chi' ix och waan yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh winh, maj satjiel-laj masanil chonhab' yuj, yuj chi' wach' ix ajxikan heb' aj Judá.

Ix yik'xi yip yopisio winhaj Roboam chi' t'a Jerusalén chi'. 41 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal. 17 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén, haton jun chonhab' chi' sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová t'a yol smakb'en heb' israel yik skajnaj ta'. Naama sb'i ix snun winh, aj Amón ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh, te chuk, yujto maj yak'och winh t'a sk'ol sk'anab'ajan tas ix yal Jehová.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Roboam chi', ayik ix el yich masanto t'a slajwub', tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yumal yuj winhaj Semaías yet' t'a yumal yik winhaj Iddo, haton heb' winh schekab' Dios.
Ix yak'nhej owal winhaj Roboam yet' winhaj Jeroboam. Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Roboam chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Abías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
